name: Gleirschalm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Gleirschalm in Tirol!**

Nestled high above the **Innsbruck** valley, the **Gleirschalm** is a true alpine paradise. Whether you're seeking adventure or relaxation, this cozy mountain hut offers breathtaking views, hearty **Tiroler** hospitality, and unforgettable experiences.

**Hiking & Nature**
Explore the stunning trails around the **Gleirschalm**, from gentle walks through alpine meadows to challenging ascents. The **Karwendel** and **Zillertal** ranges await with their rugged beauty and crystal-clear lakes.

**Culinary Delights**
Indulge in traditional **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and fresh mountain trout. The hut’s rustic charm and warm atmosphere make every meal a highlight.

**Winter Wonderland**
In winter, the **Gleirschalm** transforms into a snowy retreat. Enjoy cross-country skiing, snowshoeing, or simply unwind with a hot **Glühwein** while taking in the snowy peaks.

**Family-Friendly**
With its welcoming atmosphere and plenty of activities, the **Gleirschalm** is perfect for families. Kids will love the playful trails, and parents can relax with a view of the endless alpine scenery.

**Accommodation**
Stay overnight in comfortable rooms or cozy dormitories. The **Gleirschalm** offers a true taste of alpine life—simple, authentic, and unforgettable.

**Location & Access**
Reachable by car or via the **Nordkettenbahn** (cable car) from **Innsbruck**, the **Gleirschalm** is easily accessible year-round.

**Plan Your Visit**
Open from **May to October** (summer) and **December to April** (winter), the **Gleirschalm** invites you to experience the magic of the **Tiroler** Alps.

**Come and discover why the Gleirschalm is a hidden gem in Tirol!**
